title: Totem Tools
description: Adds two new totems to the game! A fire and a ice totem. The ice totem creates a layer of ice below your feet while the fire totem keeps you safe in lava.
body:
Adds two new totems to the game! A fire and a ice totem. The ice totem creates a layer of ice below your feet while the fire totem keeps you safe in lava.
